transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We are flying blind — we cannot make calibrated decisions on mitigation, lockdowns, or resource allocation until we know the true infection rate, IFR, and spread; surge testing is the highest-leverage action in week one.

actions.rationale: We are flying blind — we cannot make calibrated decisions on mitigation, lockdowns, or resource allocation until we know the true infection rate, IFR, and spread; surge testing is the highest-leverage action in week one.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from confirmed affected regions buys critical weeks of reduced seeding pressure at relatively low economic cost while we gather data.

actions.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from confirmed affected regions buys critical weeks of reduced seeding pressure at relatively low economic cost while we gather data.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: PPE, ventilator, and test-kit supply chains have 6–12 week lead times — invoking the Defense Production Act now prevents a catastrophic equipment shortage if the outbreak accelerates.

actions.rationale: PPE, ventilator, and test-kit supply chains have 6–12 week lead times — invoking the Defense Production Act now prevents a catastrophic equipment shortage if the outbreak accelerates.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Starting a crash vaccine and therapeutics program immediately maximizes the probability of having medical countermeasures before a potential second wave; every week of delay costs weeks at the back end.

actions.rationale: Starting a crash vaccine and therapeutics program immediately maximizes the probability of having medical countermeasures before a potential second wave; every week of delay costs weeks at the back end.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: An information vacuum in week one will be filled by rumor and panic; daily transparent briefings anchored to data build the public trust we will need to sustain compliance with harder measures later.

actions.rationale: An information vacuum in week one will be filled by rumor and panic; daily transparent briefings anchored to data build the public trust we will need to sustain compliance with harder measures later.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Early emergency relief signals that health actions will be backed by economic support, dampening panic, cushioning household balance sheets, and giving us political space to take necessary public-health steps.

actions.rationale: Early emergency relief signals that health actions will be backed by economic support, dampening panic, cushioning household balance sheets, and giving us political space to take necessary public-health steps.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We need statutory authority and appropriations for everything we are launching — front-loading Congressional engagement now prevents legislative bottlenecks when speed matters most.

actions.rationale: We need statutory authority and appropriations for everything we are launching — front-loading Congressional engagement now prevents legislative bottlenecks when speed matters most.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A live, transparent national data dashboard ensures governors, hospitals, markets, and the public are working from the same verified numbers, reducing misinformation and enabling coordinated decision-making.

actions.rationale: A live, transparent national data dashboard ensures governors, hospitals, markets, and the public are working from the same verified numbers, reducing misinformation and enabling coordinated decision-making.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens.

transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.8 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 102/100. Public trust 57/100. Hospital strain 7/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 26/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: With R at 1.8 and spread confirmed across cities, masking is a low-cost, reversible, non-economically-destructive intervention that can meaningfully reduce transmission while severity data is still uncertain.

actions.rationale: With R at 1.8 and spread confirmed across cities, masking is a low-cost, reversible, non-economically-destructive intervention that can meaningfully reduce transmission while severity data is still uncertain.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: With zero deaths so far but unknown IFR, concentrating protection on the elderly and immunocompromised is the highest expected-value targeted intervention — if severity is concentrated in that group, this saves the most lives at minimal societal cost.

actions.rationale: With zero deaths so far but unknown IFR, concentrating protection on the elderly and immunocompromised is the highest expected-value targeted intervention — if severity is concentrated in that group, this saves the most lives at minimal societal cost.

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: Confidence is still LOW and the severity range spans 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic' — we cannot calibrate any further interventions without closing that uncertainty gap urgently.

actions.rationale: Confidence is still LOW and the severity range spans 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic' — we cannot calibrate any further interventions without closing that uncertainty gap urgently.

actions.name: defer_to_states

params.rationale: With hospital strain at 7/100 and no deaths, a federal lockdown is not yet justified — but governors closest to local conditions should have full federal data, resources, and authority to move faster if their situation warrants it.

actions.rationale: With hospital strain at 7/100 and no deaths, a federal lockdown is not yet justified — but governors closest to local conditions should have full federal data, resources, and authority to move faster if their situation warrants it.

transcript.sitrep:
DEVELOPMENT: A cluster at a packed event seeds cases in a dozen new states. Pressure to act -- or to stop overreacting -- is intense from all sides.

SITUATION (Week 3). Estimated infection index 3.0 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 104/100. Public trust 56/100. Hospital strain 11/100. Restriction level 1.0/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 46/100.
ASSESSMENT (HIGH confidence): the pathogen is clearly worse than seasonal flu, with meaningful hospitalization; transmissibility is very high.

actions.name: federal_lockdown_guidance

params.rationale: HIGH-confidence assessment of a severe, highly transmissible pathogen spreading exponentially across 12+ states means the cost of waiting now exceeds the cost of acting — hospital strain will hit crisis levels in weeks given R=3.0, and restrictions take 1-2 weeks to bite.

actions.rationale: HIGH-confidence assessment of a severe, highly transmissible pathogen spreading exponentially across 12+ states means the cost of waiting now exceeds the cost of acting — hospital strain will hit crisis levels in weeks given R=3.0, and restrictions take 1-2 weeks to bite.

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: With confirmed very high transmissibility now in dozens of states, reinforcing and expanding the mask mandate is a high-efficacy, low-cost layer of protection that complements movement restrictions.

actions.rationale: With confirmed very high transmissibility now in dozens of states, reinforcing and expanding the mask mandate is a high-efficacy, low-cost layer of protection that complements movement restrictions.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Public trust is fragile at 56 and we are escalating to lockdown guidance — the public must understand the HIGH-confidence scientific basis for this escalation or compliance will collapse and trust will not recover.

actions.rationale: Public trust is fragile at 56 and we are escalating to lockdown guidance — the public must understand the HIGH-confidence scientific basis for this escalation or compliance will collapse and trust will not recover.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: With hospitalization confirmed as meaningful, doubling down on shielding the elderly and high-risk population directly reduces the hospital strain that threatens to overwhelm the system.

actions.rationale: With hospitalization confirmed as meaningful, doubling down on shielding the elderly and high-risk population directly reduces the hospital strain that threatens to overwhelm the system.

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: With spread now confirmed across 12 states we need granular geographic data to target interventions, identify hotspots, and track whether restrictions are bending the curve.

actions.rationale: With spread now confirmed across 12 states we need granular geographic data to target interventions, identify hotspots, and track whether restrictions are bending the curve.

SITUATION (Week 4). Estimated infection index 4.8 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 1.
Economy index 104/100. Public trust 58/100. Hospital strain 14/100. Restriction level 3.0/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 66/100.
ASSESSMENT (HIGH confidence): the pathogen is clearly worse than seasonal flu, with meaningful hospitalization; transmissibility is very high.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: At 66/100 progress with a highly transmissible confirmed-severe pathogen, accelerating the final push to vaccine deployment is now the single highest-leverage action to end this crisis — every week shaved off deployment saves lives and economic damage.

actions.rationale: At 66/100 progress with a highly transmissible confirmed-severe pathogen, accelerating the final push to vaccine deployment is now the single highest-leverage action to end this crisis — every week shaved off deployment saves lives and economic damage.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Economy is holding at 104 partly because of relief measures — sustaining household and small-business support during continued restrictions is what keeps compliance intact and prevents a secondary economic collapse.

actions.rationale: Economy is holding at 104 partly because of relief measures — sustaining household and small-business support during continued restrictions is what keeps compliance intact and prevents a secondary economic collapse.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Public trust ticked up to 58 and the first death has occurred — I must brief the public transparently that deaths will likely rise in coming weeks as lagged infections resolve, so this doesn't shatter trust when it happens.

actions.rationale: Public trust ticked up to 58 and the first death has occurred — I must brief the public transparently that deaths will likely rise in coming weeks as lagged infections resolve, so this doesn't shatter trust when it happens.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: With hospital strain at 14 and rising and deaths now beginning, maximally shielding high-risk populations directly reduces both the death toll and the hospital burden during the weeks before vaccine deployment.

actions.rationale: With hospital strain at 14 and rising and deaths now beginning, maximally shielding high-risk populations directly reduces both the death toll and the hospital burden during the weeks before vaccine deployment.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: With the crisis confirmed at HIGH confidence and likely to extend several more weeks, we need Congressional authorization and appropriations to sustain relief, vaccine production scale-up, and hospital surge capacity.

actions.rationale: With the crisis confirmed at HIGH confidence and likely to extend several more weeks, we need Congressional authorization and appropriations to sustain relief, vaccine production scale-up, and hospital surge capacity.
